correctness.rationale: The entire 1104-face augmented matching complex is reconstructed; independent vertex-deletion polynomial confirms the exact face vector. Complete 1103-vertex 4002-incidence Hasse DAG verifies a 545-pair discrete Morse matching with exactly one 0-cell and twelve 3-cells, proving an integral wedge of twelve 3-spheres. An independent GF(2) chain reduction agrees. The 24 dihedral-layer automorphisms have full signed-face Lefschetz traces and exactly checked rational-character multiplicities, with 1 invariant class.

value.rationale: Not merely another sphere-count case: an exact homotopy certificate for the first noncubical even circular ladder is coupled to a complete 24-element automorphism character and irreducible rational decomposition. The 5/7 layer-swap splitting and unique invariant homology line are invisible to Betti numbers and are natural symmetry-sensitive invariants in recently studied prism topology. This is a meaningful finite structural benchmark, not a claimed infinite-family theorem.
